name: relation-read-on-anchor
message: reads `[data-disabled="true"]` through a relation whose anchor this element carries: the read matches inside another element with the anchor, never on this element's own state
help: for this element's own state, use `[data-disabled="true"]` as the condition key; to read an outer instance's, keep the read
